newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian copper, nickel prices gain on world uptrend.
newsitem.headline: Indian copper, nickel prices gain on world uptrend.

text.p: Indian copper and nickel prices on Thursday extended gains on scattered arrivals and an uptrend in world markets, dealers said.
Copper rose by 50 rupees to 13,150 rupees per quintal after a rise of 100 rupees per quintal on Wednesday.
Nickel also gained on the back of rising global prices while physical buying was at a low ebb. Nickel rose by 200 rupees to 37,200 rupees per quintal.

Aluminium was steady at 7,250 rupees per quintal, zinc at 6,900 rupees and lead at 4,550 rupees on nominal trade. Tin was available at the previous level of 34,400 rupees per quintal but volumeS were dull.
